authorization_state.statement: This packet is a READ-ONLY candidate audit. No ingredient mapping, product-presentation mapping, promotion entry, or attested draft byte has been created or changed. Nothing here authorizes a runtime rule.

architecture_finding.question: Should warfarin-clarithromycin be an exact named child (warfarin__clarithromycin_oral) while the broader macrolide row stays diagnostic?
architecture_finding.class_row_promotion_blocked_because: warfarin__macrolide_cyp_inhibitor declares runtime members [clarithromycin, erythromycin] but carries exactly one evidence record, an openFDA clarithromycin label whose own normalized_proposition states it 'Supports CLARITHROMYCIN only'. Promoting the two-member class from clarithromycin-only evidence would be mechanical class expansion.

engine_simulations.design: Add exact child; leave class row members unchanged.
engine_simulations.observed: warfarin+clarithromycin raises BOTH warfarin__macrolide_cyp_inhibitor/major AND warfarin__clarithromycin_oral/major.

engine_simulations.design: Add exact child AND remove clarithromycin from the class row members.
engine_simulations.observed: warfarin+clarithromycin raises only warfarin__clarithromycin_oral; warfarin+erythromycin still raises warfarin__macrolide_cyp_inhibitor.

engine_simulations.design: Add exact child carrying suppresses:[warfarin__macrolide_cyp_inhibitor]; class row members unchanged.
engine_simulations.observed: Suppression did NOT apply; both findings still raised.
engine_simulations.root_cause: The class-row finding resolves to clinical_action_status 'unresolved_pending_applicability', and canExplicitlySuppress() in src/lib/interaction-engine.mjs refuses to suppress an unresolved finding (isUnresolvedFinding guard).

architecture_finding.consequence_for_attestation: SIM_B changes the attested draft (adds one row, edits one row). Per the handover conditional this requires deterministic JSONL ordering, full reassembly, live re-verification, refreshed attestation and derived indexes, and a newly bound exact draft-row SHA-256. The existing class-row review status must NOT be treated as authorization for the new child. This audit deliberately stops before making that change.

new_findings_not_in_handover.finding: The macrolide class row has zero erythromycin evidence. Its only evidence record is the clarithromycin label. If clarithromycin is moved to an exact child (SIM_B), the class row is left asserting a major warfarin interaction for erythromycin with no supporting evidence record at all.
new_findings_not_in_handover.required_action: Either source and review independent erythromycin evidence, or reduce/retire the class row rather than leaving an unevidenced single-member class.

new_findings_not_in_handover.finding: RxNorm exposes TWO distinct 500 mg oral-tablet concepts for clarithromycin: 'clarithromycin 500 MG Oral Tablet' and '24 HR clarithromycin 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet'. The PMBJP catalogue row for code 380 carries form_raw:null and only the brand string 'Clarithromycin Tablets IP 500 mg', which does not distinguish immediate-release from extended-release.
new_findings_not_in_handover.required_action: Code 380 cannot be bound to an exact presentation concept without disambiguating evidence. Excluded from this round. Precedent for handling an explicit ER concept separately exists (tramadol 24 HR ER, rxcui 833709).

new_findings_not_in_handover.finding: PMBJP drug code 380 (500 mg) does not appear anywhere in tender RC-222/2025, and no 500 mg clarithromycin line exists in that document. Only the 250 mg product is tendered there.
new_findings_not_in_handover.required_action: Code 380 has no official PMBI tender binding from the document set examined. A different official tender/amendment must be located and reviewed before code 380 may be proposed.

new_findings_not_in_handover.finding: A third clarithromycin-bearing PMBJP row exists that the handover did not list: code 2097, 'Combipack of Clarithromycin 500mg Tablets IP, Esomeprazole 40mg Tablets IP (Gastro resistant) and Tablets in Mono Amoxycillin 750mg Tablets IP Carton' (H. pylori eradication combipack). Its ingredient identity resolves to the separate canonical ingredient 'combipack of clarithromycin', not 'clarithromycin'.
new_findings_not_in_handover.required_action: Must be explicitly excluded. A combipack is not a single-ingredient oral tablet assertion and must never inherit a clarithromycin mapping.

openfda_clarithromycin_label.fragment_text: Spontaneous reports in the postmarketing period suggest that concomitant administration of clarithromycin and oral anticoagulants may potentiate the effects of the oral anticoagulants.

envelope_payload_sha256_drift.interpretation: The whole-response envelope hash differs because the openFDA API response envelope carries mutable meta (including last_updated). The content-bearing identifiers all match: set_id, spl_version 23, effective_time 20230530, and the verbatim fragment. This is envelope drift, not label content drift.

concepts_500mg: 24 HR clarithromycin 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet
rxnorm_presentation_concepts.note: 250 mg resolves to exactly one oral-tablet concept. 500 mg is ambiguous (see finding F2).

code_740_binding.extraction_method: pdftotext page-scoped extraction; serial/drug-code pair column aligned 1:1 with the 18 item names on page 64

code_380_binding.reason: No 500 mg clarithromycin line and no drug code 380 present anywhere in RC-222/2025.

catalogue_snapshot.provenance_restriction: janaushadhi/onemg-live provenance is restricted; internal evaluation and candidate discovery only, never redistributable production-open output.

must_not_absorb.reason: Distinct catalogue ingredient identity for the H. pylori combipack (code 2097). Must never resolve to the clarithromycin single-ingredient identity.

product_presentation_candidates.presentation_evidence: Official PMBI tender RC-222/2025 page 64 item 122 / drug code 740 states 'Clarithromycin Tablets IP 250 mg'. Presentation is taken from the tender document, NOT inferred from the catalogue brand string.

product_presentation_candidates.blocked_reason: No official tender binding located (F3) and the 500 mg strength is ambiguous between immediate-release and 24 HR extended-release oral tablet concepts (F2).

proposed_rule_if_approved.pair_count_rationale: Only PMBJP code 740 clears every evidence chain, crossed with the three already-reviewed warfarin oral-tablet assertions (2141, 2142, 452). This is 3 pairs, not the 6 that two clarithromycin products would have produced.
clinical_workflow_constraints: The prescriber or anticoagulation service directs warfarin review and PT/INR monitoring.
The pharmacy must not change a dose or stop either medicine independently.
No universal PT/INR schedule is invented.
No fixed post-discontinuation interval is invented.
US label evidence is preserved as US evidence and is not presented as an Indian regulatory-label claim.
Scope is limited to the exact reviewed product assertions above.

excluded_catalogue_assertions.reason: No erythromycin evidence exists anywhere in the audited rule. Must remain excluded unless independently sourced and reviewed (finding F1).
Already governed by the separate approved rule warfarin__azithromycin_oral (moderate). Must not be absorbed into a macrolide class promotion.
H. pylori combipack (clarithromycin + esomeprazole + amoxicillin). Distinct ingredient identity; not a single-ingredient oral tablet (finding F4).
500 mg product blocked by findings F2 and F3.
Non-tablet presentation; RxNorm exposes non-tablet forms for this ingredient. No suspension assertion is reviewed.
Parenteral presentation; outside the oral-tablet scope and unreviewed.

excluded_catalogue_assertions.exclusion: 24 HR clarithromycin 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet
excluded_catalogue_assertions.reason: Distinct extended-release presentation concept; not the immediate-release assertion under audit.
345 catalogue products contain clarithromycin. Only the exact reviewed assertion above may ever be authorized; a reviewed ingredient does not authorize every product containing that ingredient.

items: A1. Approve the ingredient identity clarithromycin = RxNorm 21212 (tty IN), UNII H1250JIK0A, as an exact mapping, explicitly not absorbing 'combipack of clarithromycin'.

A2. Approve the product-presentation mapping presentation:pmbjp:740:oral-tablet bound to product_id sha256:7a9b5161... and product_assertion_sha256 153530a9..., on PMBI tender RC-222/2025 page 64 item 122 evidence, internal-evaluation profile only.

A3. Decide the architecture: create exact draft row warfarin__clarithromycin_oral and remove clarithromycin from warfarin__macrolide_cyp_inhibitor members (SIM_B), accepting that this changes the attested draft and requires reassembly, live re-verification, refreshed attestation, and a newly bound draft-row SHA-256.
A4. Decide the fate of the residual macrolide class row, which after A3 would assert a major warfarin interaction for erythromycin with zero evidence (finding F1).
A5. Approve the clinical rule warfarin__clarithromycin_oral as major / confirm_and_monitor for internal evaluation only, limited to the 3 exact reviewed product pairs.
A6. Confirm that PMBJP code 380 stays excluded pending official tender evidence and immediate-release disambiguation.
explicitly_not_authorized_by_this_packet: Any runtime promotion or compiled runtime rule.
Any change to the attested draft pack.
Any promotion of the existing warfarin__macrolide_cyp_inhibitor class row.
